resources.string: A training log that keeps up with you between sets, and keeps your data yours.
Distances and body measurements follow along. Settings has the details.
Build routines from the exercise catalog, folders and supersets included. Or just start a workout and add exercises as you go.
Last time’s numbers are already there. Tick a set off and the rest timer starts by itself. Your workout keeps running in the notifications.
Records the moment you set them, a chart for every lift, a streak that counts weeks, and a report each month.
Everything stays on this phone. Sync it with your own Google Drive for a backup that’s always current, and the same log on every phone.
Using Liora on another phone? Connect the same account and your workouts come over.
Google couldn’t be reached. You can connect later in Settings › Your data.
